page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a stress-ng single-core performance score of 1577.49 and a multi-core score of 16666.15. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 932.17 GB/sec, which drops to 88.33 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In database operations, the instance demonstrates strong throughput, achieving 16.05 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a Passmark database score of 6071.77.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.hfr7.4xlarge offers a balanced resource density for memory-intensive applications without the overhead of local storage. This profile makes it highly suitable for in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise application servers, and memory-bound data processing tasks. The absence of local SSDs and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance as a cost-efficient choice for workloads that prioritize memory capacity and CPU stability over local high-speed storage or parallelized acceleration.
